announcement.note: (Monday; WotC said so in the Oct 12, 2026 announcement)

estimates.why: P(act) ~58%: WotC's Oct 12 'very likely ... very hard look at the Eldrazi package' (~60%), +10 for the Eldrazi family at ~20% on MTGGoldfish (Eldrazi Ramp #1 at 12.2%) and Broodscale still converting (3 of the Nov 11 Challenge top 8, 3 of 8 incl. the win on Nov 10; Spellslinger rates Broodscale Bloodchief S-tier for top-8 conversion), -12 for organic correction (Spellslinger: mono-green Broodscale share down from 10.9% to 6.3% while Rakdos Delirium rises to 7.1%, effective archetypes steady near 32; Broodscale won none of the last three RCs). Goldfish and Spellslinger disagree on the trend, so this is not averaged. x P(Command picked) ~30%: Emrakul, the Promised End or Blade of the Bloodchief are the narrower enablers and the consensus pick; the Command is a flexible 4-of in 20% of all Modern decks, which WotC avoids hitting.
#40 Legacy staple in ~12% of decks; WotC called Legacy Eldrazi proactive and fair. No ban pressure.
Not a Vintage restriction candidate; in Commander it is in 0.78% of EDHREC decks and not on the Game Changers list (Scryfall: 53 Game Changers, Command not among them).

summary: WotC's Oct 12 update warned it is 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package' if Eldrazi keeps sitting on top, and named Kozilek's Command as a bridge to Emrakul in Broodscale Combo. The deck is still the most played (Eldrazi Ramp 12.2% on MTGGoldfish, Broodscale Bloodchief 13% on MTGTop8) and put 3 decks in each of the Nov 10 and Nov 11 Challenge top 8s, but Spellslinger shows its share falling and it won none of the last three Regional Championships, so a Nov 30 hit on the archetype is somewhat better than a coin flip. If WotC acts, Emrakul or Blade of the Bloodchief is the likelier pick; the Command is a real but secondary target.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (last 2 weeks)
sources.takeaway: 598 decks (last 2 weeks): Broodscale Bloodchief #1 at 13%, Eldrazi Ramp 0.5%.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (full)
sources.takeaway: Eldrazi Ramp #1 at 12.2%; Eldrazi-family decks ~20.2% combined (Eldrazi 3.0%, Eldrazi Tron 3.0%, Broodscale 1.4%+0.2%, Mono-Green Eldrazi 0.4%).

sources.title: Modern Format Staples
sources.takeaway: Kozilek's Command #14 staple, 20% of decks; Sowing Mycospawn #27 (17%), Emrakul #35 (15%), Blade of the Bloodchief #48 (13%), Basking Broodscale #49 (13%).

sources.title: Legacy Format Staples
sources.takeaway: #40 Legacy staple, ~12% of decks: no Legacy ban pressure.

sources.title: Kozilek's Command
sources.takeaway: ~82K decks, 0.78% inclusion, not a Game Changer: no Commander ban pressure.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 11)
sources.takeaway: 54 players, won by Living End; three Broodscale Bloodchief in the top 8, all at 5-8th.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 10)
sources.takeaway: Broodscale Bloodchief took 1st, 2nd and 3-4th of a 46-player Challenge; the winning list runs Eldrazi Temple and Emrakul.

sources.title: Eldrazi Ramp (Mono-Green Eldrazi Broodscale)
sources.takeaway: Goldfish's Eldrazi Ramp is the Broodscale combo deck: 4 Kozilek's Command, 4 Eldrazi Temple, 4 Mycospawn, ~4 Emrakul in every list.

sources.title: Unity League Finals - Nationals Germany 2026
sources.takeaway: Won by Living End; two Broodscale Bloodchief in the top 8 (3-4th, 5-8th).

sources.title: Banned and Restricted Announcement - October 12, 2026
sources.takeaway: No Modern changes; 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package'; Command named as a bridge to Emrakul; next B&R Nov 30.
